title: Hinomori Shiho — Technical Expert〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It's been so long since the three of us had lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been having lunch with Ichika and the others for the most part, or listening to recordings from practice whenever I was by myself...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry for refusing your invitations until now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, that's totally fine. We knew that you were really busy preparing for your solo show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Excuse me... Um, is Hinomori here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, aren't those girls from Class C...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho's right over here!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Sorry to bother you during lunch.
This one apparently wants to tell you something desperately.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
H-Hinomori!
Your solo show was really amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you were there...?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: She saw you guys play during the night festival, and she's been a fan of your band ever since!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: So, I went over to congratulate Tenma and Hoshino earlier...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Then, they suggested that I go over to see you and Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Y-Your show was so incredible!
I'm absolutely going to go see your next show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks...
Then, we promise to also do our best next time.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good for you.
Again, sorry to bother you like this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not a problem.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That was so nice of her, Shiho. And it sounds like Leo/need has a lot more fans now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it's also a little embarrassing since we all go to the same school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, this is gonna sound really silly...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you guys sounded so much more powerful at the live house compared to when you played at the night festival.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I was also totally blown away.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An even said how it felt like you created this amazing sea of sound.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka seemed to enjoy herself too!
Oh, Shizuku was in tears right from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I know...
Her eyes were still bloodshot when I got home after the show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Not only did the crowd enjoy the show, but so did everyone who's been supporting Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm really glad.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know I'm tooting my own horn here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I'm really proud that we were able to put on such an amazing solo show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I couldn't be happier to hear that you all genuinely enjoyed it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Of course...!
Again, Shiho, congratulations.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I still need to thank Ichika and the others.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (For pursuing the same dream as me. For sticking together...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And it's not really a dream anymore. We're almost there.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I get to be in a band with them.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Teehee.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm...? Why are you two smiling like that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because you seemed really happy just now, Shiho. It's really infectious.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? I was smiling that much...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It was a really beautiful smile.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Stop, that's really embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Minori & Kohane
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.
